description: Producteurs eau potable par commune du SAGE NRG is a dataset listed in Gers-OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SAGE NRG. Structures en charge de la production d'eau potable par commune du SAGE Neste et Rivières de Gascogne en 2022 La Commission Locale de l’Eau Neste & Rivières de Gascogne, en charge de l’élaboration du Schéma d’Aménagement et de Gestion des Eaux, met à disposition à l’ensemble du public l’ensemble des fichiers cartographiques ouverts issus de ... Coverage: Gers. The portal files it under Développement durable. Its keywords are SAGE, AEP. The portal shows 660 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-01-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gers-fr-portal.
